objective: Expand the Android timer app into a modular local-first productivity suite with routines, reminders, widgets, calendar, backup, focus mode, richer insights, settings, categories, goals, audit history, and Chinese-capable resource-driven UI.
constraints: No local Gradle build or test execution; CI remains the build and test authority.
Breaking refactor is allowed; no backward compatibility required.
Prefer low-overhead background behavior with durable state recovery.
Maintain Chinese support through Android string resources.
exit_criteria: Room schema and repository support routines, categories, goals, richer instances, backup export/import, and audit history.
UI exposes Today, Routines, Calendar, Insights, and Settings surfaces with resource-driven strings.
Notifications, alarms, widgets, shortcuts, and quick tile are wired into the local-first architecture.
Static resource/reference verification passes and CI can take over build/test validation.
